acceptanceCriteria: An anchor at an undeclared revision refuses with a typed corpus error naming the repository and revision.
docs_get can select a path in a named additional repository; the same path in two repositories is not ambiguous.
Native, test-knowledge and behavior_repositories anchors either support additional repositories or refuse with a typed reason; single-repository corpora stay byte-identical.
body: V1-1986 (PR #1259, DCP-V1-175..179) added manifest additional_repositories with per-repository identity, reads and freshness for provider anchors. Still primary-only: the native provider, test-knowledge anchors, /2 behavior_repositories, symbol re-resolution (marked uncertain) and the receipt's top-level repository. An anchor at an undeclared revision still fails with the old untyped Git error instead of a typed refusal, and docs_get --path cannot distinguish the same path in two repositories.
title: Corpus additional repositories: native provider, test-knowledge, /2 behavior repositories and docs_get --path stay primary-only (GitHub #1243 residuals)
